<|channel|>analysis<|message|>We must analyse each option compared to user manual text to see which is correct.

Option A: Projection angle adjustable 0-8 degrees, minor adjustments left/right. Process: lift front, press release button, then raise/lower front adjust feet to desired length. To retract adjustment feet, press down to lower projector. Let's check manual: In Section "Adjusting the Projector Elevation Angle" (page 32): 1. Lift front and press release button. 2. While holding down release button, raise/lower front until elevation adjustment foot is approx length needed. 3. Release release button to lock. 4. Rotate the elevation adjustment foot for fine adjustment. This matches. Then for retract: "To retract the elevation adjustment foot, hold down the release button and slide the elevation adjustment foot back into the projector. Never try to forcibly change the elevation adjustment foot position without pressing the release button." Option A says: "To retract the adjustment feet, you can simply press down to lower the projector to its normal angle." That is not accurate: need to hold release button and slide foot back, not press down. So A is partially correct but last part wrong. It says "press down to lower the projector to its normal angle." That is wrong. The manual says hold release button, slide foot back. So A is not fully correct.

Option B: First time on, language selection window appears. Use arrow keys to highlight desired language. Once language set, it cannot be changed permanently, so users should choose carefully. Manual says: "A ‘Language’ window will be projected the first time you turn on the projector. Use the cursor [S] and [T] keys to highlight the language you want to use. Press the [ENTER] key. This applies the selected language, closes the 'Language' window, and displays the projected image from the connected device. You can change the display language selection later, if you need to. For details, see ‘Option Settings J Language’ on page 98." So B is incorrect: language can be changed later.

Option C: "When focusing the image displayed by the projector, it should be done using a non-static image. Typically, zooming after focusing will not change the focus of the image. You can use the zoom function to adjust the projection position and screen size." Manual: "Use the zoom ring to adjust the image size, and the focus ring to focus the image. It is best to have a still image on the screen when you focus the image. Performing zoom after focusing can cause the image to go out of focus. If this happens, focus again." So focusing with a still image is correct. But C says "should be done using a non-static image" (meaning not static?). It says "You can use the zoom function to adjust the projection position and screen size." That's normal: zoom adjust size, not position. The manual says use zoom ring to adjust size, focus ring to focus. It says zoom after focusing can cause image to go out of focus. The statement "zooming after focusing will not change the focus of the image" is wrong: it will change focus. Wait manual says performing zoom after focusing can cause image to go out of focus. So zoom would affect focus. So C is wrong.

Option D: Lamp replacement procedure: After ~2000 hours, LAMP indicator flashes red, need to turn off projector, unplug AC. Wait 60 minutes for lamp to cool fully. Then "turn the projector upside down, loosen the lamp cover, remove the screws fixing the lamp box, pull out the lamp box, insert the new lamp, secure the screws, and reattach the lamp cover." Let's check manual: Lamp replacement section: "To replace the lamp: 1. Turn off projector and unplug AC power cord. 2. Wait for at least 60 minutes to allow lamp to cool. 3. Turn over projector and place it on top of a desk or stable surface. 4. Loosen lamp cover screw, remove lamp cover. 5. Loosen three screws securing lamp cartridge, pull out lamp cartridge. 6. Insert new lamp cartridge as far as it will go. 7. Secure lamp cartridge with screws. 8. Return lamp cover to original position, secure screw." It does not mention turning projector upside down. But "turn over the projector" basically means flip it. That is ascending. "Turn the projector upside down" may be slightly wrong phrasing but could be acceptable. Does manual mention "turn the projector upside down"? It says "Turn over the projector and place it on top of a desk or ...". That's flipping 180 degrees. So that part is correct. "Loosen lamp cover" yes. "Remove screws fixing lamp box" yes. "Pull out lamp box" yes. "Insert new lamp" yes. "Secure screws" yes. "Reattach lamp cover" yes. So D matches manual. Also note after replacement, you need to reset lamp time? But not required in the description. The manual says after replacement, you need to reset lamp time. But the question likely just about procedure. D seems correct.

Thus Option D is correct. Let's double-check Option A: Some part wrong. Option B wrong. Option C wrong. So final answer is D.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|>\boxed{D}
